name: razer_report_crc
comment: XOR of report bytes [3..88] (buffer incl. report id) stored at [89]

name: razer_feature_transact
comment: HidD_SetFeature(91 bytes) then poll HidD_GetFeature until txn/class/id echo with status 0x02 (OK); returns status

name: open_hid_device
comment: enumerate HID interfaces (or WinUSB GUID for BL 1.x/3.0) matching VID/PID[/bcd], picks MI/COL by report type flags, opens handle

name: stop_dependent_services
comment: EnumDependentServicesW + ControlService(STOP) on each (used by DoStopSvc)
